summary: Frontend-only run focused on this iteration's features; PDF and backend were skipped. All requested flows PASSED. (1) TOC Bagian 3 is titled 'Membaca Pasar dengan Pikiran Jernih'. (2) toc-link-kata-pengantar goes to spread 13-14, and page 14 shows real Kata Pengantar text. (3) toc-link-profil-penulis goes to 195-196: author-profile-card shows the 'OH' avatar with no photo, and the bio continues on 197-198 with the PROFIL PENULIS header. (4) Notes: in highlight mode, clicking bab-1:2 and profil-penulis:0 highlights them without flipping the page. In the sidebar Stabilo tab, note-add, note-input, note-save and note-text all work. The note persists in ht-notes after reload, and the block gets the blk-noted class (also in reading view). Clearing the note removes it. highlight-jump goes to 23-24. (5) Reading mode on desktop: btn-reading-mode shows reading-view and unmounts the flipbook. Body text is 17px. toc-link-bab-5 scrolls #sec-bab-5 to the top. ws-p1-bigwhy accepts input. Quiz options get opt-selected. Highlight toggles blk-hl on and off. Toggling back returns the flipbook to the Bab 8 spread (chapter-opener-8 visible). Mobile 390x844 with cleared storage: reading-view is the default, text is 16.5px, there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390) and the toolbar fits. Regression: next/prev/arrow keys, bookmark add/list/remove, and the sound toggle (ht-sound 0/1) all work. Section next/prev in reading mode works. No page errors.

ui_bugs.component: Toolbar page-indicator after leaving reading mode
ui_bugs.issue: toggleReadMode sets current to the section start page, which is usually an even, right-hand page (e.g. 80 for Bab 8). Pageflip then shows spread 79-80, but onFlip does not fire, so the indicator reads 'Hal. 80–81' and a bookmark would save page 80 instead of the visible spread. Fix: on desktop, normalise current to the left page of the spread (even and >0 -> current-1), or sync current from pageFlip().getCurrentPageIndex() after the flipbook mounts.
On spreads, the subtitle uses the left page's section, e.g. 'Ucapan Terima Kasih' on the Kata Pengantar spread and 'Kesimpulan' on the Profil Penulis spread.

issues: The page indicator still shows a spread range (e.g. 'Hal. 38–39') in reading mode, which means little in a scroll view. Consider showing only the section's start page.
TOC jumps over long distances on mobile use smooth scroll and take about 3-4s to arrive at the end of the book (e.g. Profil Penulis); behavior 'auto' would feel snappier for long jumps.

action_items: Optional: normalise current to the spread's left page when returning from reading mode on desktop (fixes the indicator and bookmark page)
Optional: derive the toolbar section title from the right page when the left page belongs to a previous section
Optional: show a single page number in the reading-mode indicator
critical_code_review_comments: Reader.jsx toggleReadMode/onReadSection: current is set to built.starts[key] without parity normalisation for spread mode
Reader.jsx: hlItems is still recomputed on every render (wrap in useMemo)
TocSidebar HlRow: draft is initialised from notes only on mount; this is fine because the row remounts, but editing the same note from two places is not synced (minor)
seed_data_creation: none (localStorage only: ht-hl, ht-notes, ht-bm, ht-mode, ht-ws/ht-quiz)
context_for_next_testing_agent: There are 200 pages (indicator '/ 199'). Kata Pengantar is p14 and Bab 1 text p23-24 (bab-1:2 on p23). Profil Penulis runs p196-198; p196 has the author card. Bab 8 opener is p80. Toolbar testids: btn-toggle-toc (not btn-toc), btn-reading-mode, btn-highlight-mode, btn-bookmark, btn-sound-toggle, page-indicator, current-section-title. localStorage ht-mode='read'/'flip' overrides the viewport default. In reading mode, sections are #sec-{key}; smooth scroll needs about 2-4s for long jumps.
